title: BCN versus HAM same-modality site shift (ISIC dermoscopy)

B0_domain_signal_threshold.interpretation: Probe at or above 0.70 counts as a domain signal worth adversarial removal, compared against the label-only reference (~0.67 plain accuracy), not against 0.5.
B0_domain_signal_threshold.stop_rule: If balanced accuracy is near 0.5 (pre-specified band: 0.45-0.55), report ISIC site homogeneity and do not run B1.

B0b_trivial_shift_controls.preprocessing: Identical centre crop, resize to 448, same interpolation and normalization as Phase 15 single-encoder eval; document exact torchvision ops in run config.
B0b_trivial_shift_controls.border_masked_probe: Report site probe balanced accuracy on unmasked features and with a fixed circular border mask (dermoscope vignette region zeroed before embedding).
B0b_trivial_shift_controls.label_only_probe: Logistic site classifier from ground-truth class index only (no image), as reference line.

data_definition.ham_holdout_for_ood: Disjoint HAM lesion partition never in L_adv (mirror pad_heldout); all OOD AUROC/ECE/confidence on that holdout only.

B2_sweep_protocol.dense_lambda_rule: Three seeds densely in the interval where coarse scan shows the steepest drop in binary site leakage on held-out HAM, plus lambda=0 anchor with identical recipe.

gate_criteria.success: Adversary at chance at convergence after best-epoch CE meaningfully below ln(2).
gate_criteria.null_experiment: At chance from epoch 1 and never below ln(2) (Camelyon17-class null).
gate_criteria.lambda_zero: Control only; not interpreted as null.

B3_outcome_mapping.1_leakage_falls_task_intact_detectors_in: Modality confound closed; claim covers same-modality site shift.
B3_outcome_mapping.2_detectors_chance_no_invert: Partial: collapse generalises; inversion may need larger gap. Report both.
B3_outcome_mapping.3_leakage_falls_detectors_flat: Effect needs large domain gap; narrows claim; explains Camelyon17/iWildCam negatives.

priority_note: Part B outranks new WILDS work; do not queue further iWildCam beyond finishing in-flight eval jobs.
